title: Dev studio
description: HTML files as cards; Dev mode edits a page the way Figma edits a frame
description_ru: HTML-файлы карточками; дев-режим правит страницу, как Figma правит фрейм
about: HTML files of the library as cards on the Hyimg canvas, a live sandboxed page when big on screen; Dev mode: the page's DOM tree, the live page and an inspector of the selected element; it edits the file in place: colours, fill, stroke, corners, type, opacity, padding, size and text, a :root variable for this element or everywhere, undo with ⌘Z
